translation.Login.Consent.Age: I am at least {{age}} years old or my parents or guardians agree.
translation.Login.Consent.Intro: Please read the key points and agree to the terms of use. Only then is your JBLBase account created.
translation.Login.Consent.IntroLichess: The first sign-in with Lichess creates a JBLBase account. Please agree to the terms of use first. If you already have an account, this confirms the current version.
translation.Login.Consent.IntroUpdate: There is a new version of the terms of use and privacy policy for your JBLBase account. Nothing is synced until you agree. Your files on this device stay as they are.
translation.Login.Consent.Point.Backup: Syncing is not a backup: a repertoire deleted on one device disappears on the others too.
translation.Login.Consent.Point.Data: Your e-mail address or Lichess ID, linked usernames, your repertoires and your training progress are stored with Google Firebase (database in Frankfurt; sign-in may also be processed in the USA).
translation.Login.Consent.Point.Delete: You can delete your account and all cloud data at any time yourself (Settings → Profile & accounts). The files on your devices stay.
translation.Login.Consent.Point.Free: The account is free and run in spare time. There is no guarantee that the cloud service is always available or offered for good. Liability is limited to intent and gross negligence.
translation.Login.Consent.Point.NoTracking: No tracking, no ads, no selling of data.
translation.Login.Consent.Point.OpenSource: JBLBase is a private open-source project under the GPL-3.0, based on En Croissant. You may read, change and share the code.
translation.Login.Consent.Point.ThirdParties: Lichess and Chess.com are separate providers with their own privacy rules. The app contacts them directly from your device.
translation.Login.Consent.Title: Before your account is created
translation.Login.Consent.TitleUpdate: New terms of use and privacy policy
translation.Login.PrivateCloud: The cloud is private: only accounts the operator of JBLBase has approved can sync. Without approval the app works as usual, just without the cloud.
